faq.a: Ferdous is associated with the Persian form فردوس, whose core sense is heavenly beauty, paradise.

faq.q: What is the origin of Ferdous?
faq.a: Ferdous is associated with Persian. Ferdous, from Old Iranian *paridaiza ('walled garden'), the source of Arabic firdaws ('paradise'). The source record's gloss 'Heavenly beauty' is an approximation. The source record classified it as Arabic, which is incorrect.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Ferdous can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ferdous should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. الفردوس occurs in the Qur'an (e.g. 18:107)

faq.q: What does Ferdous mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ferdous is rendered فردوس and carries the sense جنت کی خوبصورتی، فردوس.

faq.q: What does Ferdous mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ferdous is rendered فردوس and carries the sense زیبایی بهشتی، فردوس.
A romanized syllable approximation is fer-dous. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ferdous?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ferdous, ferdous. Script forms are فردوس, फ़िरदौस.

faq.q: Is Ferdous a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
